title: The Shadow Bank That Only Loans Against Funeral Insurance Payouts
hook: If you're dying soon, this private bank lends you cash today — secured against the policy your family will collect when you're gone.
why_this_can_go_viral: Death-based lending is morbid, taboo, and reveals a hidden economy most viewers never knew existed.

title: The Billionaire Who Secretly Buys All Unsold Cremation Urns
hook: He owns a warehouse full of urns that were never claimed — and uses the ashes themselves as anonymous collateral in offshore accounts.
why_this_can_go_viral: The combination of death, secrecy, and exploitation of the unclaimed dead is deeply unsettling and unforgettable.

title: The Dark Money Flow That Runs Through Closed Psychiatric Hospitals
hook: Abandoned asylums don't rot — they're bought by shell trusts that trade patient records as bearer bonds on a private market.
why_this_can_go_viral: The exploitation of mental health records for wealth transfer is a horrifying hidden system that feels both true and dystopian.

title: The Economic Crime That Counterfeits Every Unclaimed Veteran's Benefits

title: The Financial Manipulation That Shorts Every Quit Notice Before It's Given

why_this_can_go_viral: The tragedy of abandoned academic work turned into a private intellectual vault strikes a chord with students and creators.
